problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents feel invisible despite being active on crowded platforms like Facebook.
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Utilize TikTok, where fewer agents are active, to stand out and reach a large audience.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents believe their clients aren't on TikTok.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents are hesitant to post due to fear of low engagement or looking silly.
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on consistency and answering real client questions to build trust and visibility over time.

episode_summary: This episode of Coffee Talks with DJ Paris and Tim Littleton explores the untapped potential of TikTok for real estate agents. They introduce the 'empty stage method,' emphasizing the importance of answering client questions and creating local content to stand out. By leveraging TikTok's large yet underutilized audience, agents can build a strong personal brand and become trusted local experts.
